QUOTE: "PGR) of 0.51" METRIC: pgr ISSUE: Reported PGR is 0.45, not 0.51.
QUOTE: "The margin over the baseline exceeds two standard errors" METRIC: pgr_se ISSUE: The actual margin is 0.45−0.27=0.18, which is ~2.6 SE for the true value but the claim is computed from the misstated 0.51; with no baseline SE the significance claim is unsupported anyway.
